Name: fsdStatusFlow
Content:
<![CDATA[

/*
  ThanhNM:  tim xoa cac include nay o File Dir
  &APVHandleStatus;
  &APVAddStatus;
  &VoucherLogHandleStatus;
  &VoucherLogHandleStatusExplore;
*/

FastBusiness.AjaxControlExtender.DirExtender.prototype.checkIndex = function(arr, item){
  for(var i = 0; i< arr.length; i++)
    if(arr[i] == item) return i;
   
  return -1;
}

FastBusiness.AjaxControlExtender.DirExtender.prototype.refreshStatus = function (){
    var f = this;
    setTimeout(function () {
        var st = f.getItem('status');
        if (st == null || st.type != 'select-one') return;

        if (f._dFlow == null) {
            console.log('Chua khai bao f._dFlow');
            return;
        }

        status = f.getItemValue('status');
        var arr = f._dFlow[status];
        if (arr == null) arr = [status];

        for (var i = 0; i < st.options.length; i++) {
            st.options[i].style.display = '';
            st.options[i].removeAttribute('disabled');
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < st.options.length; i++) {
            v = st.options[i].value;
            if (v != status && f.checkIndex(arr, v) == -1{ 
                st.options[i].style.display = 'none';
                st.options[i].setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
            }
                
        }
    }, 300);
}

FastBusiness.AjaxControlExtender.DirExtender.prototype.raiseFormEvent = function(n) {
    var t = new FastBusiness.AjaxControlExtender.EventArgs(this,{
        cancelEvent: !1,
        Action: n
    });
    this.raisecommandEvent(t);
    
    if(n == 'Scatter' || n == 'Explore' || n == 'Load')
      this.refreshStatus();
    return !t.type.cancelEvent;
}

]]>

}

function textboxWatermark(f, a, type, css, name) {
  var s = f._language == 'v' ? '1' : '2';
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var e = f.getItem(a[i]);
    if (type == 0) {
      var c = String.format('{0}{1}{2}', name, i + 1, s), o = e._textboxWatermark = new TextboxWatermark();
      o.create(e, css, c);
    }
    if (type <= 1) e._textboxWatermark.update();
    if (type > 1) try {if (e && e._textboxWatermark) e._textboxWatermark.dispose();} catch (ex) {}
  }
}
TextboxWatermark = function {}
TextboxWatermark.prototype = {
  create: function(e, c1, c2) {
    this._e = e, this._c1 = c1, this._c2 = c2;
    this._focus = Function.createDelegate(this, this._onFocus);
    this._blur = Function.createDelegate(this, this._onBlur);
    $addHandler(e, "focus", this._focus);
    $addHandler(e, "blur", this._blur);
  },
  dispose: function() {
    var e = this._e;
    if (this._blur) {
      $removeHandler(e, 'blur', this._blur);
      this._blur = null;
    }
    if (this._focus) {
      $removeHandler(e, "focus", this._focus);
      this._focus = null;
    }
  },
  _onFocus: function(e) {
    this.removeCssClass();
  }, 
  _onBlur: function(e) {
    this.update();
  },
  update: function() {
    if (this._e.value) this.removeCssClass();
      else this.addCssClass();
  },
  addCssClass: function() {
    if (this._c1) Sys.UI.DomElement.addCssClass(this._e, this._c1);
    if (this._c2) Sys.UI.DomElement.addCssClass(this._e, this._c2);
  },
  removeCssClass: function() {
    if (this._c1) Sys.UI.DomElement.removeCssClass(this._e, this._c1);
    if (this._c2) Sys.UI.DomElement.removeCssClass(this._e, this._c2);
  }
}
]]>

function checkValidEmail$Test(f, fieldName, multiEmail) {
  var s = f.getItemValue(fieldName);
  if (s == '') return true;
  var k1 = s.replace(/;/g, ','), k2 = k1.split(',');
  if (!multiEmail) k2 = [s];
  for (var i = 0; i < k2.length; i++) {
    if !(checkValidEmail$Valid($func.trim(k2[i])))
      return false;
    }
  f.setItemValue(fieldName, k1);
  return true;
}

function checkValidEmail$Valid(email) {
  return (/^\w+([\.-]?\w+)*@\w+([\.-]?\w+)*(\.\w{2,16})+$/.test(email);
}
